subject: AI & Agents
title: The Three Types of Machine Learning
description: A 60-second lesson on The Three Types of Machine Learning.

hook.text: There are three ways machines learn: from answers, from patterns, and from rewards.

buildup.text: Supervised learning uses labeled data. Unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns. RL uses rewards.

discovery.text: Spam detection is supervised. Customer segmentation is unsupervised. Game-playing is reinforcement.

twist.text: Modern systems often combine all three — pre-train unsupervised, fine-tune supervised, align with RL.

climax.text: ChatGPT uses all three in sequence: pre-training, instruction tuning, then RLHF.

punchline.text: The best learners use every method available.

quiz.question: What are the three main types of machine learning?

details.summary: Machine learning has three main approaches: supervised learning uses labeled examples, unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns, and reinforcement learning trains through trial, error, and rewards.
details.whyItMatters: Each type suits different problems. Knowing which approach fits which situation is fundamental to choosing the right ML strategy for any given task.
takeaways: Supervised learning uses labeled input-output pairs
Unsupervised learning discovers structure without labels
Reinforcement learning optimizes through reward signals

faq.question: Which type of machine learning is most commonly used?
faq.answer: Supervised learning is the most widely deployed type because labeled data enables precise training. Most commercial AI applications — from spam filters to medical imaging — use supervised approaches.

faq.question: Can these three types be combined?
faq.answer: Yes. Semi-supervised learning combines labeled and unlabeled data. Self-supervised learning creates labels from the data itself. Modern systems like ChatGPT use pre-training, fine-tuning, and RLHF across all three types.
